title: Planta Plant Care Event Weekly Days Since Watering Trend
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=planta:plant days_since_watered=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_since_watered) as avg_duration, max(days_since_watered) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days since watering for Planta plant care event events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_since_watered on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days since watering with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether Planta plant care event tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
